title: Care Closet Survey: Partner Check-In
intro: Please share your input so we can best serve your district in the school days ahead. Your answers tell us what your students need most, and we'll use them to plan the donations that make the greatest impact. Thank you!

questions.title: Which district or organization do you represent?
Will you continue to be the contact for the upcoming school year?

followUp.title: If known, please share the name and contact information of the next contact.
followUp.placeholder: Name, email, phone — whatever you have

questions.title: Based on previous donations, how many students could be impacted in the upcoming school year?
questions.helper: A rough estimate of the potential impact is fine — a number, a range, or a short description.

questions.title: How would you like your funds allocated?
questions.helper: Let's Ketchup has allocated a budget for each Care Closet partner, and we want to make sure what we purchase is focused on the needs of your district. Unless you tell us otherwise, funds are split evenly across the three categories below. Set the percentages to show us where your budget will help most — they must total 100%.

questions.title: Which non-perishable food items are most needed?
Would you like to keep receiving Popchips?
questions.helper: In addition to your selections in this survey, Our Home in Kankakee provides a large donation of Popchips for Kankakee County students. If you would not like Popchips, please let us know below.

options.label: No thanks — please leave us out of the Popchips donation

questions.title: Which hygiene items are most needed?
Which clothing items are most needed?
questions.helper: All items are unisex except underwear and leggings. Pick an item and we'll ask which sizes you need — that way what arrives is what your students can actually wear.

options.label: Not sure / Variety of sizes needed
Not sure / Variety of sizes needed

questions.title: Are there any additional items, needs, or considerations not included in this survey that would better support your school district?
questions.helper: You are welcome to share additional requests, such as other items, allergy-related considerations, or preferred clothing colors. We will take these requests into consideration when possible; however, they are not guaranteed and will be secondary to the selections made earlier in the survey.

questions.title: May we publish your name and school district with your testimonial?
questions.helper: This assists with fundraising and grant writing — via social media and/or included in grant information. Thank you for your previous input that has helped our impact resonate beyond the numerical data!

followUp.title: Thank you — would you like to write your testimonial right here?
followUp.helper: Since you're happy for us to share it, here's the box to write it in. A sentence or two about what the Care Closet has meant for your students is plenty, and you're welcome to write more. You can also leave this blank and send one along later.
followUp.placeholder: What the Care Closet has meant for your students…

questions.title: What is your input on the delivery process from this year?
questions.helper: What went well overall and/or what would you want to change, if anything?

questions.title: Please include any other comments or questions, if you have them!
questions.helper: We thank you for your work in meeting the needs of your students!

thankYou.title: Thank you!
thankYou.body: Your responses help us make sure every Care Closet is stocked with what students actually need. We're grateful for your partnership — more good days ahead!
